description: Implementation of resource grid writing functions for a physical layer component, including methods to get resource dimensions, write symbols to resource grid, and access views of resource elements.

classes.name: resource_grid_writer_impl
classes.description: Class implementing methods to write and access resource grid data for physical layer processing.

methods.name: get_nof_ports
methods.description: Returns the number of ports in the resource grid.

methods.name: get_nof_subc
methods.description: Returns the number of subcarriers in the resource grid.

methods.name: get_nof_symbols
methods.description: Returns the number of symbols in the resource grid.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Writes symbols into the resource grid at specified position, with overloads for different symbol types.

methods.name: get_view
methods.description: Provides a view of the resource grid data for a specific port and symbol index.
